svg.title: APEX 09 — What APEX does — and what it is worth
svg.text: What APEX does — and what it is worth
Four built and tested products behind one secure front door: a solution showcase, a presentation library and an
academy that turns playbooks into certified capability. The value differs by persona, so we state it in their words.

g.text: scoped roles, organisations, audit log and
usage analytics and a monthly PDF
meetings turned into owned action items.
THE VALUE, IN EACH PERSONA’S WORDS
Turn the firm’s know-how into visible,
verified capability and faster wins — on
Know what your teams use and
See usage and completion by team; keep
encrypted tokens, audit log, optional AI
Find, present and learn in minutes, from
Add a capability platform to your
Self-hosted: data stays on the customer’s servers and in its own Dropbox; files are proxied,
Playbook-to-certificate pipeline with traceability from every lesson back to its source
Assessment integrity: grading on the server, answers never reach the browser, certificates
AI drafts, people decide: AI is optional, human-approved, with daily and monthly spend caps.
One governed identity: scoped roles, organisations and an audit trail across products.
On the roadmap — say so plainly
Hosted deployment with Postgres and HTTPS
Live Dropbox connection in all products
Email delivery for invites and reminders
Privacy self-service: data export and erasure

svg.text: Sell the combination no single tool gives: portfolio, sales library and certified learning, self-hosted on
the customer’s own storage. Be explicit that hosting, SSO and live Dropbox are still on the roadmap.
Capability status shown on the poster where relevant
Readiness: capabilities marked LIVE are built and tested; none is yet proven in a customer production environment. No customer results, ROI, certifications or prices are claimed.
November 2026 · Internal sales enablement · A0 841 × 1189 mm
